from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document with its identifying and case classification information."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title/name of the judgment document as it appears")
    case_category: str | None = Field(description="Broad case category: 'criminal', 'civil', or 'administrative'")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific case cause/案由 as stated in the document")
    criminal_charge: str | None = Field(description="Specific criminal charge if this is a criminal case, e.g., '盗窃罪', '诈骗罪'")
    legal_category: str | None = Field(description="The criminal law category this case falls under if applicable, e.g., '侵犯财产罪', '侵犯人身权利罪'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
